title: What eBPF Taught Me About Linux Observability
description: I wanted to see what was happening below the application layer without adding another agent. Here's what eBPF changed about how I observe Linux systems.

title: Why My Python Metrics Died After Gunicorn Forked
description: I had metrics working locally and completely disappearing in production. That turned out to be a process-model problem, not a Prometheus problem.
